content.title: 7-1-2-3. Collocation.
content.summary: No WCF owner or operator shall unreasonably exclude a wireless communications competitor from using the same facility or location. Upon request by the Director, the owner or operator shall provide evidence explaining why collocation is not possible at a particular facility or site.

faqs.a: No WCF owner or operator shall unreasonably exclude a wireless communications competitor from using the same facility or location. Upon request by the Director, the owner or operator shall provide evidence explaining why collocation is not possible at a particular facility or site.
